rows.Rate: reimbursement of fees for prescribed courses (excluding amounts owed under the Higher Education Contribution Scheme)
reasonable compensation for damage to clothing and personal effects
reimbursement for reasonable out-of-pocket expenses, including transport expenses

rows.Allowances: Meal allowance - working through three agreed meal break periods in a day
Permanent transfer to another location reimbursement
rows.Rate: reimbursement for reasonable travelling expenses for the employee and their family and the transfer or storage of furniture and personal property
reimbursement for additional personal insurance to cover any existing personal insurance policies that would be invalidated by such travel

reimbursement for the cost of insuring against injury or death by accident from any air travel other than by regular passenger carrying service or any duties performed in a war zone or warlike operations

rows.Allowances: Spectacle allowance - in receipt of a health fund benefit
rows.Rate: reimbursement for the difference between the cost of the spectacles and the benefit, with a maximum of $122.88 on the first frames.The employer will not be liable for the tinted or outdoor component of any lenses.

rows.Allowances: Spectacle allowance - not in receipt of a health fund benefit
rows.Rate: reimbursement for the cost of the lens and up to $122.88 on the first frames.The employer will not be liable for the tinted or outdoor component of any lenses.

rows.Allowances: *Sub-editing allowance - country non-daily newspaper or a regional daily newspaper
rows.Rate: 5% of the employee's minimum hourly rate per hour for an employee who works a full shift as a sub-editor

rows.Allowances: Temporary transfer to another location reimbursement
rows.Rate: reimbursement for all reasonable expenses for accommodation and travel
